visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a bright, mirrored dance studio with white walls and laminate flooring, a muscular Asian man with short hair, wearing a white oversized t-shirt and white trousers, stands at the front. He wears a professional headset microphone and addresses a small group of about eight men sitting on the floor; some are shirtless, and some wear casual gym clothes. The lighting is bright studio light, casting minimal shadows. (2) The scene shifts to the instructor being shirtless, revealing a tanned and highly defined muscular physique. He wears vibrant orange, white, and black board shorts with 'Hhn' branding. He stands before a wall-mounted mirror performing bodybuilding poses like the front lat spread, while the students stand behind him mimicking his movements with focused expressions. (3) The instructor moves through the group of shirtless students, who wear various colors of board shorts. He uses his hands to physically adjust their posture, pressing on their shoulders and rotating their hips to correct their form. The background shows professional studio fans and speakers in the corners of the well-lit room. (4) A montage sequence shows the men lined up in a row performing synchronized poses like the front double bicep and back lat spread. The camera uses handheld panning and close-ups to highlight muscular detail. The instructor continues providing verbal cues and physical corrections while observing their collective form in the mirrors. (5) The video concludes with the group posing together, laughing in a relaxed manner. The final frame transitions to a close-up shot of black boxes stacked together featuring the white 'MARS' logo and Traditional Chinese text indicating 'Mixed Whey Protein 72 Packets'.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) An energetic, high-tempo K-pop/Electronic track with a strong synth-driven beat and driving percussion begins immediately. A male voice, speaking Traditional Chinese with an authoritative tone, provides instruction through a headset. His delivery is clear and projected over the music at a moderate volume. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect marks a transition between visual cuts, while the background music maintains a consistent 115 BPM rhythm. The instructor's voice becomes more animated, shifting in pitch and intensity to match the pace of the bodybuilding demonstrations occurring in the studio environment. (3) The acoustic space exhibits a slight natural room resonance, with occasional low-level chatter and appreciative laughter from the students heard between vocal cues. The music remains the dominant layer, featuring layered synthesizers and a punchy electronic bassline that maintains high arousal. (4) As the session concludes, the music track exhibits a dramatic harmonic buildup with increased spectral brightness. A final percussive impact marks the end of the posing sequence, transitioning to a brand-themed jingle or a clean audio tail as the background music fades out completely.
